rows.feature: Persistent copyable Git failure banner classifies push rejection/divergence/conflicts/dirty-overwrite/auth/network/no-upstream, secret scanning, file-size/LFS/protected-branch/hooks, missing remote/repository and unknown failures. Offers only matching recovery.
rows.interaction_contract: Persistent copyable Git failure banner classifies push rejection/divergence/conflicts/dirty-overwrite/auth/network/no-upstream, secret scanning, file-size/LFS/protected-branch/hooks, missing remote/repository and unknown failures. Offers only matching recovery.
rows.state_failure_platform: Full raw stderr survives until dismiss or later success; not a fleeting/truncated toast. Recovery may pull/merge/rebase/force-with-lease/continue/skip/abort/open conflict/publish/retry. Reauthenticate only copies `gh auth login`; it does not automatically run login. Server-rule failures have no fake repair button.
